''Dendrobenthamia capitata'' }} '''''Cornus capitata''''' is an Asian species of [[dogwood]] known by the common names '''Bentham's cornel''', '''evergreen dogwood''', '''Himalayan flowering dogwood''', and '''Himalayan strawberry-tree'''.{{APNI | name = ''Cornus capitata''| id =221219 | accessdate = 24 July 2013 }} == Description == This is an [[evergreen]] tree growing to {{Convert|12|m|abbr=off}} in height and width. The leaves are gray-green and pale and fuzzy underneath, and several centimetres long. It flowers during the summer, with [[cymes]] of white [[bract]]s supporting small greenish flowers. The [[infructescence]] is a small aggregate of several individual fruits fused into a red body {{Convert|2 or 3|cm|abbr=on|frac=4}} across. {{gallery|mode=packed |Cornus capitata C.jpg|Bark |Cornus capitata in Christchurch Botanic Gardens 04.jpg|White [[bract]]s and small greenish flowers |CORNUS CAPITATAweb.jpg|Fruit }} == Taxonomy == There are several varieties and [[Hybrid (biology)|hybrids]]. The common name ''Bentham's cornel'' derives from the alternative label ''Benthamia fragifera'', coined by [[John Lindley]] in honour of fellow botanist [[George Bentham]].{{Cite book|last=Royle|first=John Forbes|url=https://catalog.hathitrust.org/Record/009726679|title=On Benthamia fragifera, and the climate of Mussooree, its native country|publisher=W Nicol|year=1834|location=London|page=3|language=English}} == Distribution and habitat == It is native to the low-elevation woodlands of the [[Himalayas]] in [[China]], [[India]], [[Pakistan]], [[Nepal]], and [[Bhutan]]. It is [[introduced species|naturalized]] in parts of [[Australia]] and [[New Zealand]], but is also grown elsewhere as an [[ornamental plant|ornamental]]. The species is naturalised in the states of [[New South Wales]] and [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] in Australia. == Uses == The fruit is edible but usually bitter.{{Cite book |last=Fern |first=Ken |url=https://archive.org/details/plantsforfuturee0000fern/page/26/mode/2up |title=Plants for a Future: Edible & Useful Plants for a Healthier World |date=2000 |publisher=Permanent Publications |isbn=978-1-85623-011-7 |location=Hampshire |pages=27}} == References == {{reflist}} ==External links== * {{commonscatinline|italic=on}} * {{PFAF|Cornus capitata}} * [https://web.archive.org/web/20080424083227/http://www.canopy.org/db/main.asp?tree=202 Canopy Trees] {{Taxonbar|from=Q168335}} [[Category:Cornus|capitata]] [[Category:Trees of China]] [[Category:Trees of the Indian subcontinent]] [[Category:Trees of Myanmar]] {{Cornales-stub}}
